# RP animation catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/animations/build_profiles.py. -->

The synchronized RP API ships with client 2.31.13+op77.45 and the matching server runtime.
Start with the [role-play animation guide](rp-animations.md) for installation, Lua examples and known limitations.
Authored workspot and male/female rig bindings have been checked; this does not certify every clip.
Only the default smoke action has a local-male visual check. Other variants and female/remote presentation
remain experimental. The per-profile validation labels below conservatively describe asset coverage.

Each action uses an Open77 workspot derived from its vanilla source, not the historical single cigar device.
Selectable clips have isolated loop containers; authored rig, prop and exit data are preserved.
Durations and loop timing are not inferred from clip names. All actions are stationary.

## Discovery inventory

The complete extracted common-workspot inventory is [rp-workspots.json](../docs/data/rp-workspots.json).
It records workspot hashes, source animsets, rigs and animation-node roles. It is not a playback allowlist.
The older [raw clip list](../docs/data/emote-animations.txt) also contains quest and special-rig clips.
